title: HydroGuard: a controlled release hydrogel-phage delivery system to combat catheter-associated urinary tract infections.
authors: Rao, Shilpa; McLean, Rhyan; Zakir Hussain, Aadila
one_liner_zh: 该文开发水凝胶-噬菌体递送系统对抗导管相关尿路感染，虽含蛋白质设计、数学建模和模拟，但核心对象是抗菌材料系统而非蛋白质结构计算，算法框架部分可迁移至蛋白体系。
abstract: Catheter-associated urinary tract infections (CAUTIs) rank as the fourth-most significant nosocomial infection globally. CAUTIs account for approximately 80% of hospital-acquired urinary tract infections and represent nearly one-third of all device-associated infections. Urinary catheters serve as a hub for bacteria to form highly resistant biofilms containing pathogens, like Enterococcus (E.) faecalis that reduce effectiveness of the immune system and antibiotic treatments. Therefore, tackling biofilm formation at the catheter surface becomes a crucial step in mitigating CAUTIs. We aim to address E. faecalis biofilm formation by engineering HydroGuard: a Gelatin Methacryloyl (Gel-MA)-based hydrogel injected with bacteriophages, to provide targeted, enzyme-triggered antimicrobial activity. Enterococcus faecalis expresses gelatinase (GelE), a zinc metalloprotease that enhances biofilm formation. GelMA is susceptible to GelE-mediated degradation, enabling enzyme-triggered release of bacteriophages that specifically lyse E. faecalis. For a Biosafety Level 1 proof-of-concept experiment with a well-studied host and phage system, we heterologously expressed GelE in Escherichia (E.) coli DH5alpha to emulate native E. faecalis expression. This system was tested on dynamically grown biofilms, to simulate similar conditions to the urinary tract. Currently, the E. coli system has shown preliminary inhibition when tested against the hydrogel product, however testing of different phage combinations is needed. Mathematical modelling identified hydrogel crosslinking density as a critical tuneable parameter governing therapeutic availability and predicted nonlinear, degradation-dependent phage release profiles. Sensitivity analyses revealed design trade-offs between structural stability and antimicrobial responsiveness. Together, the biofilm, hydrogel, phage-bacteria, and protein design models form a multiscale computational framework that links biofilm development and environmental conditions to enzyme-mediated hydrogel degradation, phage release, and bacterial suppression. Agent-based biofilm simulations captured emergent spatial dynamics under nutrient, flow, and pH constraints, while a coupled predator-prey model investigated phage-bacteria population dynamics within the degrading GelMA matrix. Computational protein design further explored collagen-like peptide motifs with enhanced folding stability and preserved gelatinase cleavage sites, providing a molecular-level approach to tuneable degradation kinetics. This multiscale framework provides predictive insight into how biofilm conditions, hydrogel degradation, and phage availability interact within the proposed system, while the preliminary experimental observations provide supporting evidence for its feasibility. By integrating synthetic biology, tissue engineering, and modelling, HydroGuard offers a novel, non-antibiotic strategy for CAUTI prevention.
abstract_zh: 导管相关尿路感染（CAUTIs）在全球医院获得性感染中排名第四。CAUTIs约占医院获得性尿路感染的80%，并占所有设备相关感染的近三分之一。导尿管作为细菌形成高度耐药生物被膜的枢纽，其中包含如粪肠球菌（E. faecalis）等病原体，这些病原体降低了免疫系统和抗生素治疗的有效性。因此，解决导尿管表面的生物被膜形成成为减轻CAUTIs的关键步骤。我们旨在通过工程化HydroGuard来应对粪肠球菌生物被膜形成：一种基于明胶甲基丙烯酰（Gel-MA）的水凝胶，注入噬菌体，以提供靶向、酶触发的抗菌活性。粪肠球菌表达明胶酶（GelE），一种增强生物被膜形成的锌金属蛋白酶。GelMA易受GelE介导的降解，从而实现酶触发的噬菌体释放，这些噬菌体特异性裂解粪肠球菌。为了进行生物安全一级概念验证实验，使用一个研究充分的主机和噬菌体系统，我们在大肠杆菌（E. coli）DH5alpha中异源表达GelE，以模拟天然粪肠球菌的表达。该系统在动态生长的生物被膜上测试，以模拟类似尿道的条件。目前，大肠杆菌系统在针对水凝胶产品测试时显示出初步抑制作用，但需要测试不同的噬菌体组合。数学建模确定了水凝胶交联密度作为控制治疗可用性的关键可调参数，并预测了非线性、依赖降解的噬菌体释放曲线。敏感性分析揭示了结构稳定性与抗菌响应性之间的设计权衡。综合起来，生物被膜、水凝胶、噬菌体-细菌和蛋白质设计模型形成了一个多尺度计算框架，将生物被膜发展和环境条件与酶介导的水凝胶降解、噬菌体释放和细菌抑制联系起来。基于代理的生物被膜模拟捕捉了营养、流动和pH约束下的新兴空间动态，而耦合的捕食者-猎物模型研究了降解GelMA基质内的噬菌体-细菌种群动态。计算蛋白质设计进一步探索了具有增强折叠稳定性和保留明胶酶切割位点的胶原样肽基序，为可调降解动力学提供了分子水平的方法。该多尺度框架提供了对生物被膜条件、水凝胶降解和噬菌体可用性在所提出系统内如何相互作用的预测性见解，而初步实验观察为其可行性提供了支持证据。通过整合合成生物学、组织工程和建模，HydroGuard为CAUTI预防提供了一种新颖的非抗生素策略。
